requirements.statement: make every `Sandbox` value satisfy `Experimental_SandboxSession` from `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.64 directly, with no adapter, wrapper, or cast

scenarios.name: When a `Sandbox` from `cloudflareSandbox`, `bash()`, `local()`, or `sandboxFromDriver` is assigned to a variable typed `Experimental_SandboxSession`, the type check shall pass with no cast.
when: a `Sandbox` from `cloudflareSandbox`, `bash()`, `local()`, or `sandboxFromDriver` is assigned to a variable typed `Experimental_SandboxSession`

requirements.statement: keep the framework extensions on `Sandbox`: `cwd`, `resolvePath`, `stat`, `readdir`, `exists`, `mkdir`, and `rm`, with relative paths resolved against `cwd` in every file operation

scenarios.name: When `readTextFile` is given a relative path, the system shall read the file at that path resolved against the sandbox's `cwd`.
then: read the file at that path resolved against the sandbox's `cwd`

requirements.statement: replace `Sandbox.exec` with the session's `run` and `spawn`, and accept an optional `timeoutMs` on their options that is forwarded to the provider's native deadline where the provider has one, and enforced through an abort signal otherwise

scenarios.name: When `run` is called with `timeoutMs`, the system shall pass that deadline to the provider's native timeout option, or enforce it with an abort signal when the provider has none, rounding up and never down.
then: pass that deadline to the provider's native timeout option, or enforce it with an abort signal when the provider has none, rounding up and never down

requirements.statement: replace the framework's `readFile(path)`, `readFileBuffer(path)`, and `writeFile(path, content)` with the session's `readFile`, `readBinaryFile`, `readTextFile`, `writeFile`, `writeBinaryFile`, and `writeTextFile`, including their contract that a missing file resolves to `null`

scenarios.name: When `readTextFile` or `readBinaryFile` targets a path that does not exist, the system shall resolve to `null` rather than reject.
when: `readTextFile` or `readBinaryFile` targets a path that does not exist

scenarios.name: When `writeTextFile` targets a path whose parent directories do not exist, the system shall create them and write the file.
when: `writeTextFile` targets a path whose parent directories do not exist
then: create them and write the file

requirements.statement: keep the existing abort and liveness contract for `run` and `spawn`: a pre-aborted call never executes, a mid-flight abort rejects promptly, an orphaned command's eventual settlement is reported to `onOrphanSettled`, and on providers that detect sandbox death, that death rejects with `SandboxDiedError`

scenarios.name: If `run` is called with an `abortSignal` that is already aborted, then the system shall reject without executing the command.
when: `run` is called with an `abortSignal` that is already aborted

scenarios.name: When the `abortSignal` aborts while a driver-backed `run` is in flight, the system shall reject promptly with an `AbortError`.
when: the `abortSignal` aborts while a driver-backed `run` is in flight

scenarios.name: When an aborted driver-backed command later settles, the system shall report its settlement to `onOrphanSettled`.
when: an aborted driver-backed command later settles

scenarios.name: If the sandbox dies while `run` is in flight on a provider that detects sandbox death, then the system shall reject with `SandboxDiedError`.
when: the sandbox dies while `run` is in flight on a provider that detects sandbox death

requirements.statement: deliver `spawn` output live on `local()` and `cloudflareSandbox`, and on completion on `bash()` and driver-backed sandboxes, with `wait`, `kill`, and abort working on all of them

scenarios.name: While a command started with `spawn` on `local()` is still running, the system shall deliver the output it has already written on `stdout`.
given: a command started with `spawn` on `local()` is still running
then: deliver the output it has already written on `stdout`

scenarios.name: When a command started with `spawn` on `bash()` or a driver-backed sandbox finishes, the system shall deliver its full output on `stdout` and `stderr`.
when: a command started with `spawn` on `bash()` or a driver-backed sandbox finishes
then: deliver its full output on `stdout` and `stderr`

scenarios.name: When a command started with `spawn` on `bash()` or a driver-backed sandbox finishes, the system shall resolve `wait()` to its exit code.
when: a command started with `spawn` on `bash()` or a driver-backed sandbox finishes

scenarios.name: When `kill()` is called on a spawned process, the system shall settle its `wait()`.
when: `kill()` is called on a spawned process

requirements.statement: keep every existing `SandboxDriver` implementation valid without changes, and have `sandboxFromDriver` produce the new `Sandbox` from it

scenarios.name: The `SandboxDriver`-based sandbox blueprints' driver code shall type-check against `SandboxDriver` without changes.

requirements.statement: adapt the three built-in providers, `cloudflareSandbox`, `bash()`, and `local()`, to the new `Sandbox`, each with a `description` of its environment
port the built-in tools (read, write, edit, bash, grep, glob) onto the new methods with no change to what the model sees

scenarios.name: When the model's read or edit tool targets a missing file, the system shall return a tool error that names the path, with the same wording on every provider.
when: the model's read or edit tool targets a missing file
then: return a tool error that names the path, with the same wording on every provider

requirements.statement: update every page under `packages/cli/docs` that calls or documents the removed `Sandbox` methods, including the sandbox and agent API references, the sandbox and tool guides, and the Cloudflare, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI deploy pages, and the `sandbox--cloudflare-computer` blueprint, which implements `Sandbox` directly rather than through `SandboxDriver`
keep the public `session.fs` and `session.shell` unchanged in names, signatures, and behaviour, including `session.fs.readFile` throwing on a missing file

scenarios.name: When `session.fs.readFile` targets a missing file, the system shall reject, as it does today.

requirements.statement: add `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` to `tech-stack.md` before it becomes a dependency of `@amond-ai/agent`
mark the removal of `exec` and the old file-method signatures as a breaking change in the commit history, so release-please records it
cover the new `Sandbox` contract with tests that run on all three built-in providers. `@amond-ai/agent` has no tests today, so these are new
